entities.summary: Ellis Robert Kolchin was an American mathematician at Columbia University. He earned a doctorate in mathematics from Columbia University in 1941 under supervision of Joseph Ritt. Shortly after he served in the South Pacific in World War II. He was awarded a Guggenheim Fellowship in 1954 and 1961.
